title: Set Up Your First API Token
excerpt: Create, name and secure your very first API token in under one minute.

content.p: After logging in, open the Token menu in the sidebar. This is where all of your API keys live.

content.caption: A fresh token is like a keycard for the API

content.p: A readable name like prod-webapp or staging-script helps you recognize the token later in the usage logs.
You can leave the quota unlimited or set a cap. Setting a quota is a great safety net for long-running jobs.
The token is shown only once. Copy it immediately and store it in your secret manager.
Done! Your token is now ready to authenticate every request 🎉.

faq.q: Why should I set a quota on my token?
faq.a: A quota caps how many credits a single token can spend, so a runaway script can never drain your balance.
Yes, create as many as you need, each with its own name, quota and expiry.

faq.q: What if I lose my token?
faq.a: Tokens are shown only once. If you lose it, delete the old one and create a replacement.
Yes. Treat it like a password — never put it in client-side code or share it publicly.
